method: SingleFile save of the same conversation as deepseek-chat.html, taken in the dark theme. Kept the external stylesheets (36 <style> blocks, ~519 KB), including the DARK syntax palette.
notes: The dark marker lives on the BODY, not the document element: <body class="zh_CN dark" data-ds-dark-theme="dark">. The page's own stylesheet keys off body[data-ds-dark-theme]. This is where the script reads it from, and the reason isDarkTheme() checks the body attribute before anything else.

All three md-code-block wrappers are md-code-block-dark, so this capture is what makes the dark variant - and the dark token palette - verifiable. Run: DSR_FIXTURE=deepseek-chat-dark bun run fixture:parity

Dark palette measured here: keyword #e9ae7e, string #91d076, function #c699e3, parameter #6cb8e6, punctuation #e3eaf2. The light capture colours fewer kinds (no parameter), so the raw view is slightly more colourful in dark mode.
